messages:
Asha Patel: Hey @Dan Lopez (Bridgewell) and team — kicking off onboarding for Bridgewell. Goal: get devs calling the Redwood API in a sandbox, complete basic fine-tune/eval loop, and verify latency/cost targets by EoQ. Can we align on stakeholders and must-have success criteria?
Dan Lopez (Bridgewell): Thanks Asha — happy to be here. My stakeholders: myself (Product), Lina Ortiz (Eng lead), and Rajiv Mehta (Security). Primary goals are: 1) replace current API for chat in the mobile app, 2) meet <200ms 95th percentile for critical paths, and 3) data residency for logs.
Marco Rivera: noted. Security + latency are the big ones. @Priya — can you map out enablement and handoff steps? Also propose a rough timeline we can show Rajiv.
Priya Shah: Yep — here's a proposed cadence:```Week 0: Access + sandbox setup (API keys, RBAC)
Week 1: Integration + smoke tests
Week 2: Model selection + quantization recommendations
Week 3: Performance tuning + load test
Week 4: Monitoring + runbook handoff```I'll share a doc with checkboxes. Link: https://redwood.app/s/bridgewell-onboard :spiral_calendar:
Asha Patel: Success criteria I want on the backlog for CSM sign-off (minimum):
- Sandbox API calls from devs (3 unique devs)
- End-to-end chat flow demo with mobile team
- 95th pctl latency <200ms on staging under 50 concurrent users
- Cost per 1k tokens estimate within 20% of projection
- Security review completed by Rajiv
Please confirm which of these are blockers for go/no-go.
Dan Lopez (Bridgewell): All look reasonable. Data residency is a blocker until we confirm log retention settings. Rajiv will want the RBAC audit.
Marco Rivera: We'll plan for RBAC + KMS proof-of-concept in Week 0. Priya will own the runbook and load-test scripts.
Priya Shah: Action items: 1) Share runbook template (today) 2) Sandbox keys + RBAC invite (by EOD Wed) 3) Load test harness + baseline script (by next Tue) 4) Schedule security sync with Rajiv (propose Thu 10am)
Asha Patel: I'll own customer success milestones and renewal-risk tracking. Note: if we miss the latency SLO after Week 3, mark as "elevated renewal risk" and open a remediation playbook.
Dan Lopez (Bridgewell): OK to Thu 10am for security. Also, can we get a short enablement session for the mobile devs? 30min lunchtime session works best.
Marco Rivera: We can do a 30min run-through in Week 2 (day to be scheduled). Will add calendar invite after security sync. :calendar:
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: security-sync meeting Thu 10:00 — invite sent to Rajiv Mehta, Lina Ortiz, Dan Lopez (Bridgewell), Asha Patel, Priya Shah.
Asha Patel: Thanks all — I'll update the shared doc with stakeholder contacts and acceptance criteria. Expect a status update in 48 hours. :thumbsup: 
Dan Lopez (Bridgewell): Thanks team, looking forward.
